title: CoreArtifactAlignmentReport 文档状态一致性清理
objective: 在 CoreArtifactAlignmentReport 已达到 passed、missing_core_alignment_count=0、migration_tasks=[] 之后，清理 TASK_QUEUE、CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE_INDEX 和 AI_COMPILATION_SYSTEM 中仍声称 needs_migration 或仍有待迁移 review pack 的过时描述，确保后续 worker 读到的事实源一致。
acceptance_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
report=json.loads(Path('examples/review_packs/core_artifact_alignment_report.v0.1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert report['summary']['overall_status']=='passed'
assert report['summary']['missing_core_alignment_count']==0
assert report['migration_tasks']==[]
for path in ['control/TASK_QUEUE.md','docs/CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE_INDEX.md','docs/AI_COMPILATION_SYSTEM_V0_1.md']:
    text=Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    forbidden=['当前报告状态为 `needs_migration`','CoreArtifactAlignmentReport 已列出当前待迁移 review pack','下一步继续把 review pack 与真实 provider 产物对齐到这些核心字段']
    for phrase in forbidden:
        assert phrase not in text, f'{path} still contains stale phrase: {phrase}'
print('core alignment doc consistency passed')
PY
notes: 本任务只做文档事实源一致性，不改 schema、tools、runtime、review pack。
不要把 passed 解释为整个项目完成；只表示当前 CoreArtifactAlignmentReport 扫描范围内无剩余迁移项。
如果 OpenCode headless 因外部数据披露策略被拒绝，允许主代理在同一 worktree 本地完成。
